statement: The Pt. Leo Estate Sculpture Park holds more than seventy large scale works by Australian and international artists.
note: Settled by the operator against a press source from 2022. The sixty figure the corpus carried traces to a Time Out listing of 4 May 2022, which is also where the 330 acre figure removed from this corpus earlier today came from.
